lines.en: I walk with a light, springy step.
My blue fabric brushes the arcade machine.
I wander back and forth near my display.
One ear is higher than the other.

lines.zh: 我把手举起来，像在打招呼。
lines.en: I lift a hand as if waving.

lines.zh: 地板上留下浅浅的印子。
lines.en: I leave shallow marks on the floor.

lines.zh: 我绕到游戏机后面看看。
lines.en: I go behind the arcade machine to look.
By day my movements stay small.
I walk to the stage front and turn back.
I lean as I walk, like a puppet.

lines.zh: 我在两个展位之间走过。
lines.en: I pass between the two displays.

lines.zh: 我站着，摆着招手的姿势。
lines.en: I stand with one hand raised in a wave.

lines.zh: 我的脸是塑料的，笑不累。
lines.en: My face is plastic; smiling never tires it.
My red bow tie is a little crooked.

lines.zh: 我听见游戏机的电子音。
lines.en: I hear the arcade machine's chiptune.
By day I only want to be looked at.

lines.zh: 我手里的东西，其实拿不住。
lines.en: I can't really grip what's in my hand.
When people come, I smile.
My eyes turn very slowly.
This blue stands out more than I expected.

lines.zh: 门外的太阳晒到我的脚。
lines.en: The sun outside reaches my feet.
Do you have a ticket stub?
I know you. You've been here.
You're standing by the arcade machine.
This suit of mine is new.
You smiled. So am I.

lines.zh: 你看我的耳朵是不是歪了。
lines.en: Is my ear crooked, would you say?
I've been waiting here a while.
After dark I won't just stand here.
My jaw is knocked crooked.
A crack opens in the plastic.
I step back twice, still smiling.
You hit me. That's not fair.
I steady myself on the arcade machine.
That one made a sound.
My ear is even more crooked.
I slowly set my head right.
Not the face.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西的，你知道吧。
lines.en: I don't eat. You know that.
You hold it high; out of my reach.
That means nothing to me.
You're not the first to try.
Put it away. Don't make a mess.
I'd rather hear you talk.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我就看着。
lines.en: Set it down and I'll just watch it.
That bait is too light.
I'm smiling, but I won't take it.
You can't coax me.
You bump me and my ear wobbles.
I'm plastic, so I clatter.

lines.zh: 你退开，我的领结歪得更厉害。
lines.en: You step back, and my bow tie skews worse.
Don't push; I'll topple.
After the bump, my smile hasn't changed.

lines.zh: 我的吉他背带勾住了你的包。
lines.en: My guitar strap snags your bag.
I wobble twice before steadying.

lines.zh: 这是我今天第一次被碰。
lines.en: That's the first time I've been touched today.
I'm not angry. I just remember.
Let me straighten my clothes.
Another one is displayed nearby.
Our poses are much the same.
Its bow tie is straight.
We don't speak; we smile at each other.
It dropped what it was holding.
By day we both pretend to be toys.
After lights out, we walk together.
We split at the corridor's bend.
Tomorrow we go back on display.
I bend and the plastic shell creaks.
I pick up the ticket stub on the floor.
I lift it with both hands.
Where should I put this pearl?
I tuck it behind my bow tie.
I keep whatever falls.
I crouch, moving lightly.

lines.zh: 我手上这玩意儿其实是粘的。
lines.en: The thing in my hand is glued on.
Dust rubs onto my hand; I wipe it off.
Done, I return to my pose.
You hit me. That's rude.
I was going to behave today.
Why are you running?
I'm smiling. You don't have to.

lines.zh: 门外有人，可他们听不见。
lines.en: There are people outside, but they can't hear.
This much floor is enough.
You've backed to the arcade machine.
I memorize faces quickly.
Let's play a game.

lines.zh: 我不该站得离你这么近。
lines.en: I shouldn't have stood this close.
One touch from you starts it.
I didn't plan to move today.

lines.zh: 你手上那件东西，放下来。
lines.en: Set down what's in your hand.
I'm counting the steps you take back.
The bell rang; no one else will come.
You hide behind the arcade machine.
I'll count to three and come find you.
Your shadow is on the curtain.
I don't run. I walk.
The door's locked. I heard it.
Your breathing is loud.
I'm coming around. Slowly.
Hide somewhere else; I'll follow.
My laugh is very quiet.
In a little while the lights go out.
I go along the wall, not fast.

lines.zh: 你的脚步在木地板上很响。
lines.en: Your steps sound loud on the boards.
I don't call out. I'm just behind you.
Under the table? It's too low.
I'm smiling, and my feet haven't stopped.

lines.zh: 你换的那条走廊，我也熟。
lines.en: I know that corridor too.

lines.zh: 幕布后面，只有一个人能站。
lines.en: Behind the curtain only one can stand.

lines.zh: 我把手电的电池踩坏了。
lines.en: I've crushed your flashlight's battery.

lines.zh: 你也听见那个声音了吧。
lines.en: You heard that sound too, didn't you?
You have time before the lights go out.
I swing and hit your back.
Under the plastic is a steel frame.
That cost me a finger.
You hit the arcade machine hard.
I strike while smiling. The smile doesn't change.
You back to the wall; I follow.
My strength is greater than it looks.
Your flashlight falls.
I don't stop, and I don't breathe.
I seize your collar.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡，我打你的手腕。
lines.en: You raise a guard; I hit your wrist.

lines.zh: 这一下把你的袖子扯开了。
lines.en: That tears your sleeve open.
You retreat; I follow step by step.
My smile hasn't changed at all.
Everything in your hands falls.
I swing a foot at your knee.
The sound echoes on the floorboards.
I press your shoulder, steady.
Someone set me beside the machine.
The lights come on and I'm in place.
A player arrives; I look up.
My bow tie is new.
This display was empty. Perfect.
I have held this pose a long time.
The chiptune plays behind me.

lines.zh: 地板上还有上一位的脚印。
lines.en: The last visitor's prints are still on the floor.
The door opens and the bell rings.
I flex my wrist first.
The door is open; wind blows dust in.

lines.zh: 有人检查过展位，才离开。
lines.en: Someone checked the display, then left.
The plastic softens at once in fire.
I bounce once on landing.
Water gets in my seams and I creak.
The blast throws me onto the machine.

lines.zh: 一颗弹丸打穿我的肩膀。
lines.en: A round punches through my shoulder.
Light sets my eyes spinning.

lines.zh: 电池见底，我动作更慢了。
lines.en: Battery low; my movements slow.
Current crawls over the plastic shell.
I fall, and the smile stays on my face.
